judgment.judgment_zh: Claude Code 是成熟的本地多 agent 运行时。2.1.290/291 加强集中治理与恢复，并修复审批回答和会话末尾消息丢失。
judgment.judgment_en: Claude Code is a mature local multi-agent runtime. Versions 2.1.290/291 strengthen central governance and recovery, and fix lost permission answers and final messages.
judgment.next_action_zh: 升级到 2.1.291 前回归 managed hook、工作区外规则文件、plan mode connector、大型 MCP 响应和重启恢复。
judgment.next_action_en: Before 2.1.291, regress managed hooks, out-of-workspace rule files, plan-mode connectors, large MCP responses and restart recovery.

judgment.judgment_zh: Qwen Code 0.25 已把多 agent 协作、A2A 分享、私有 hosted MCP、持久 shell 结果和冷会话恢复推入稳定版。恢复与审批边界持续完善，但仍缺少独立安全验证。
judgment.judgment_en: Qwen Code 0.25 moves multi-agent collaboration, A2A sharing, private hosted MCP, durable shell results and cold-session restore into stable. Recovery and approval boundaries keep improving, but independent security validation is still missing.
judgment.next_action_zh: 在非关键仓库跑一天协作任务，重启 worker，并核对审批、shell 结果与有副作用工具是否重复执行。
judgment.next_action_en: Run a one-day collaborative task in a non-critical repository, restart workers, and verify approvals, shell results, and side effects are not replayed.

judgment.judgment_zh: Copilot 已从补全转向可编排的 agent 平台。Code review 现在能从 REST 或 GraphQL 触发并逐请求设置 effort，适合纳入 CI，但应先核对有效发现率和成本。
judgment.judgment_en: Copilot has shifted from completion to an orchestrable agent platform. Code review can now be triggered through REST or GraphQL with per-request effort, making CI integration practical but still requiring quality and cost checks.
judgment.next_action_zh: 从 CI 对同一组 PR 触发 Balanced 与 High review，对比时延、成本和有效发现率。
judgment.next_action_en: Trigger Balanced and High reviews for the same PR set from CI and compare latency, cost and useful-finding rate.

judgment.judgment_zh: Agents API 已把托管浏览器、来源审批、登录交接和 session 恢复组合成可用 contract。它能减少基础设施工作，但凭据、审计和副作用确认必须由应用端严格验证。
judgment.judgment_en: The Agents API now combines hosted browsing, origin approval, sign-in handoff and session recovery into a usable contract. It reduces infrastructure work, but applications must validate credential boundaries, audit and side-effect confirmation.
judgment.next_action_zh: 用测试账号跑一次带登录的只读任务，核对凭据边界、默认拒绝、断线恢复和完整审计。
judgment.next_action_en: Run one read-only signed-in task with a test account and verify credential boundaries, fail-closed approval, recovery and audit.

judgment.judgment_zh: Cursor 正把 coding agent 从编辑器延伸到常驻的云端执行：自托管执行机、面向长期工作的 Projects、部署监控与安全审查都已推出。商业上有两个变量：SpaceX 已完成收购，OpenAI 将在 11 月 12 日停止向 Cursor 供应合同模型。
judgment.judgment_en: Cursor is extending its coding agent from the editor to always-on cloud execution: self-hosted workers, Projects for months-long work, deployment monitoring and security review have all shipped. Two business variables remain: SpaceX has completed its acquisition, and OpenAI will stop supplying contracted models to Cursor on November 12.
judgment.next_action_zh: 部署监控先用只通知模式，暂停和回滚保留人工审批；依赖 OpenAI 模型的团队提前准备替代。
judgment.next_action_en: Run deployment monitoring in notify-only mode with human approval for pause or revert; teams relying on OpenAI models should line up alternatives.

judgment.judgment_zh: Gemini CLI 0.62.0 的 OAuth、终端与 ACP 权限修复适合现有用户升级。A2A server 虽在稳定包里，仍无文档和兼容承诺，不宜作为生产依赖。
judgment.judgment_en: Gemini CLI 0.62.0 brings useful OAuth, terminal and ACP permission fixes for existing users. The A2A server ships in stable packages but still lacks documentation and compatibility commitments, so it is not a production dependency.
judgment.next_action_zh: 升级到 0.62.0，回归 OAuth 刷新、终端退出和 ACP 权限事件顺序；A2A 继续只做隔离实验。
judgment.next_action_en: Upgrade to 0.62.0 and test OAuth refresh, terminal exit and ACP permission-event order; keep A2A experiments isolated.

judgment.judgment_zh: Pydantic AI 修复了 web fetch 策略绕过和遥测内容泄露，这是运行时边界漏洞，不是小修。2.51.0 又加入 GPT-Live 支持和实时上下文用量，并降低了 agent graph 开销。
judgment.judgment_en: Pydantic AI fixed a web-fetch policy bypass and telemetry content leaks, which are runtime-boundary flaws rather than cosmetic patches. Version 2.51.0 added GPT-Live support and realtime context usage and reduced agent graph overhead.
judgment.next_action_zh: 当前版本和 v1 部署都升级，补测私网地址与 hostname 规范化策略，并审查已导出的 trace。
judgment.next_action_en: Upgrade current and v1 deployments, test private-address and normalized-hostname policies, and review already-exported traces.

judgment.judgment_zh: vLLM 0.31 继续把快速启动和服务安全做进主线：preload 覆盖 DP/MTP，加入实验性 CRIU 快照，并默认拒绝每请求多模态参数。版本仍含多项不兼容变更。
judgment.judgment_en: vLLM 0.31 keeps moving fast startup and safer serving into the mainline: preload covers DP/MTP, experimental CRIU snapshots arrive, and per-request multimodal parameters are rejected by default. The release still carries breaking changes.
judgment.next_action_zh: 分阶段升级 0.31，回归 preload、快照恢复、多模态参数拒绝、LoRA 缓存隔离和已变更的 flag。
judgment.next_action_en: Stage the 0.31 upgrade and regress preload, snapshot recovery, multimodal argument rejection, LoRA cache isolation and changed flags.

judgment.judgment_zh: SGLang 0.5.21 增加运行时 prefill/decode 角色切换并默认启用 Rust 缓存核心，但新性能数字仍需按实际负载复现。
judgment.judgment_en: SGLang 0.5.21 adds runtime prefill/decode role switching and enables the Rust cache core by default, but its new performance claims still need workload-specific reproduction.
judgment.next_action_zh: 复现 TTFT 与 prefill 吞吐，并完成 breaking changes 清单后再上线。
judgment.next_action_en: Reproduce TTFT and prefill throughput and complete the breaking-change checklist before rollout.

judgment.judgment_zh: DeepSeek V4 家族是开放权重 agentic coding 的主要选项：V4-Pro 已 GA 并原生支持 Responses API，V4.1-Flash 以 1M 上下文、开放权重和低价发布，厂商称其在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上领先。agent 运行时 Harness 和多模态 V4-Flash-Vision-Exp 仍是早期项目。
judgment.judgment_en: The DeepSeek V4 family is a leading option for open-weight agentic coding: V4-Pro is generally available with native Responses API support, and V4.1-Flash ships with a 1M context, open weights and low pricing, with a vendor-reported lead on Terminal-Bench 2.1. The Harness agent runtime and the multimodal V4-Flash-Vision-Exp are still early.
judgment.next_action_zh: 在自己的 coding 任务上比较 V4.1-Flash 的完成率与成本；自托管前评估 deepseek-recipe 运行时的集成成本。
judgment.next_action_en: Compare V4.1-Flash completion rate and cost on your own coding tasks; assess the deepseek-recipe runtime integration cost before self-hosting.

judgment.judgment_zh: Qwen 同时推进几条产品线：开放权重的 Qwen3.8-27B（262K 上下文）、实时同传 Qwen3.8-LiveTranslate，以及统一生成与编辑的 Qwen-Image-2.1。下一代 Qwen4 架构目前只通过 Flash-Next 预演。
judgment.judgment_en: Qwen is advancing several lines at once: the open-weight Qwen3.8-27B with a 262K context, Qwen3.8-LiveTranslate for live interpretation, and Qwen-Image-2.1 for unified generation and editing. The next-generation Qwen4 architecture has only been previewed through Flash-Next.
judgment.next_action_zh: 按产品线分别评估：文本模型在自有任务上测；Qwen-Image-2.1 商业使用前先确认授权条款。
judgment.next_action_en: Evaluate each line separately: test the text models on your own tasks, and confirm license terms before any commercial use of Qwen-Image-2.1.

judgment.judgment_zh: GLM-5.3 与 GLM-5.3-Flash 是这一轮中国前沿开放权重里许可最宽松的（MIT），Flash 用混合稀疏-线性注意力压低长上下文的服务成本。已有研究显示，单方向的权重编辑就能去掉 Flash 的拒绝能力。
judgment.judgment_en: GLM-5.3 and GLM-5.3-Flash carry the most permissive license (MIT) in the current wave of Chinese frontier open weights, and Flash uses hybrid sparse-linear attention to cut long-context serving cost. Research has shown that a single-direction weight edit can strip Flash of its refusals.
judgment.next_action_zh: 自托管前确认 serving 栈版本要求，在自己的长上下文任务上测单位成本；对外服务要自己补护栏。
judgment.next_action_en: Check serving-stack version requirements, measure unit cost on your own long-context tasks, and add your own guardrails before serving it externally.

judgment.judgment_zh: MCP 已进入企业治理阶段。SDK 2.3 进一步收紧重定向、token audience、连接生命周期和 SSE 负载边界，但会影响复用 server 或 transport 的旧实现。
judgment.judgment_en: MCP has entered its enterprise-governance phase. SDK 2.3 further tightens redirects, token audiences, connection lifecycles and SSE payload limits, but can break older implementations that reuse servers or transports.
judgment.next_action_zh: 回归跨域重定向、token audience、超大 SSE 负载、transport 复用和断线重连。
judgment.next_action_en: Regress cross-origin redirects, token audiences, oversized SSE payloads, transport reuse and reconnection.

judgment.judgment_zh: 档案里还没有 Kimi 模型本身的发布记录，只记录到 vLLM 0.28 为 Kimi-K3 加入了专属服务优化。这说明 Kimi-K3 已能在主流服务栈上自托管，但能力与许可需要另行核实。
judgment.judgment_en: The archive has no release record for the Kimi models themselves, only vLLM 0.28 adding model-specific serving work for Kimi-K3. That shows Kimi-K3 can be self-hosted on a mainstream stack, but its capability and license still need separate verification.
judgment.next_action_zh: 自托管 Kimi-K3 的团队先升级到 vLLM 0.28 或更新版本；采用前到官方渠道核实许可和评测。
judgment.next_action_en: Teams self-hosting Kimi-K3 should be on vLLM 0.28 or later; verify the license and evaluations through official channels before adopting it.

judgment.judgment_zh: Gemini 4 Argon 展示 1M 输出 token 和强 coding/网络安全结果，但目前只向可信防御团队开放。介绍价有明确到期后的翻倍计划，公开 API 前无法做独立工程验证。
judgment.judgment_en: Gemini 4 Argon shows a 1M-token output ceiling and strong coding and cybersecurity results, but access is limited to trusted defenders. Introductory prices are scheduled to double, and independent engineering tests must wait for a public API.
judgment.next_action_zh: 等待公开 API 与稳定计价，再用固定预算测试长轨迹成功率、漂移和人工审计成本。
judgment.next_action_en: Wait for public API access and stable pricing, then test long-run success, drift and human-audit cost under a fixed budget.

judgment.judgment_zh: Microsoft 把 Copilot 扩展为租户治理的 agent 工作区：Code 负责构建，Managed Runtime 负责沙箱与托管，Autopilot 负责持续运行。现阶段它是架构信号，还不是可以直接上线的完整栈。
judgment.judgment_en: Microsoft is turning Copilot into a tenant-governed agent workspace: Code builds, Managed Runtime handles sandboxing and hosting, and Autopilot runs recurring work. For now it is an architecture signal rather than a deployment-ready stack.
judgment.next_action_zh: 先验证 Managed Runtime 的隔离和花费控制，再给 Autopilot 的周期任务配置身份、审计和人工升级路径。
judgment.next_action_en: Verify Managed Runtime isolation and spend controls first, then give Autopilot recurring work only with explicit identity, audit and human escalation.

judgment.judgment_zh: GPT-6.1 Sol 以 Sol 价位接近 Astra 的 coding、computer-use 与专业任务能力，并已开放 API。厂商 benchmark 很强，但多 agent 仍是 beta，安全分级也更高。
judgment.judgment_en: GPT-6.1 Sol brings near-Astra coding, computer-use and professional-task capability to Sol pricing and is available by API. Vendor benchmarks are strong, but multi-agent remains beta and the safety classification is higher.
judgment.next_action_zh: 用真实轨迹与 GPT-6 Sol、Astra 比较任务成功率、事实错误、token 和单任务成本。
judgment.next_action_en: Compare real traces against GPT-6 Sol and Astra on success, factual errors, tokens and cost per completed task.

judgment.judgment_zh: 腾讯 Hy4 预览版是 Apache 2.0、1M 上下文的超大 MoE 开放权重模型，主仓月下载量已增至 22,788。完整版尚未发布，也还没有可复现的独立评测。
judgment.judgment_en: Tencent Hy4 preview is a very large Apache 2.0 MoE with a 1M context, and its main repository has reached 22,788 monthly downloads. The full model has not shipped and there is no reproducible independent evaluation yet.
judgment.next_action_zh: 等第三方在公开权重上给出可复现结果，或腾讯发布完整版，再重新评估。
judgment.next_action_en: Re-evaluate once a third party publishes a reproducible run on the public weights or Tencent ships the full model.

judgment.judgment_zh: Holo4 同时公开了权重、harness 和逐步轨迹，一个模型就能操作 GUI、执行代码并调用 MCP 与 API。27B 使用非商业许可，35B-A3B 是 Apache 2.0；厂商成绩存在单次运行和训练 split 重叠的问题。
judgment.judgment_en: Holo4 ships weights, a harness and step-by-step trajectories together, and one model can operate GUIs, run code and call MCP or APIs. The 27B model is non-commercial while 35B-A3B is Apache 2.0, and the vendor scores include single runs and overlap with training splits.
judgment.next_action_zh: 商业评估先试 35B-A3B，在自己的 harness 里重跑一小段 OSWorld 2.0 和 120 个 held-out 任务。
judgment.next_action_en: For commercial evaluation start with 35B-A3B, and rerun a slice of OSWorld 2.0 plus the 120 held-out AutomationBench tasks in your own harness.

judgment.judgment_zh: Sonnet 5.5 的单任务成本对 effort 很敏感；独立评测显示 maximum effort 可能比 Sonnet 5 更贵。
judgment.judgment_en: Sonnet 5.5 task cost is effort-sensitive; independent evaluation found maximum effort can cost more than Sonnet 5.
judgment.next_action_zh: 用自有轨迹比较 low、medium 与 maximum effort 的质量、输出 token、时延和成本。
judgment.next_action_en: Compare low, medium and maximum effort on your traces for quality, output tokens, latency and cost.

judgment.judgment_zh: Kumo Tabular 是开放权重的表格基础模型，把带标签的行当作上下文，一次前向计算完成分类或回归。四个榜单第一都是厂商自测，训练配方和合成数据生成器尚未公开。
judgment.judgment_en: Kumo Tabular is an open-weight tabular foundation model that reads labeled rows as context and classifies or regresses in one forward pass. All four leaderboard wins are vendor-run, and the training recipe and synthetic-data generator are not yet public.
judgment.next_action_zh: 用 Medium 版本在留出表格上与调优后的树模型比较准确率、校准、延迟和 GPU 成本。
judgment.next_action_en: Compare the Medium model with tuned tree ensembles on held-out tables for accuracy, calibration, latency and GPU cost.

judgment.judgment_zh: Agents Vault API 已有公开文档，secret 通过网络代理按 host 注入，可以进入受控试验。
judgment.judgment_en: The Agents Vault API is publicly documented; secrets are injected by a network proxy per allowed host, enabling a controlled trial.
judgment.next_action_zh: 测试 secret 不可见、host 白名单、轮换、撤销和日志脱敏。
judgment.next_action_en: Test secret non-disclosure, host allowlists, rotation, revocation and log redaction.

judgment.judgment_zh: Ollama 0.35.0 把概率优先的 decision model 带到本地运行时，适合路由与分类试验。现阶段只支持少量模型，概率仍需用自有标签做校准。
judgment.judgment_en: Ollama 0.35.0 brings probability-first decision models to the local runtime for routing and classification trials. Model choice is limited and probabilities still require calibration on local labels.
judgment.next_action_zh: 验证概率校准，并确认客户端不会给 decision-only 模型展示 chat、tools 或 thinking。
judgment.next_action_en: Validate calibration and confirm clients do not offer chat, tools or thinking to decision-only models.

judgment.judgment_zh: cua-speedrun 是公开的 computer-use agent 速度、成本与成功率统一评测栈。论文结果仍是作者报告，但公开基础设施足以在一天内做小规模复现。
judgment.judgment_en: cua-speedrun is a public, standardized stack for measuring computer-use agent speed, cost and success. Results remain author-reported, but the open infrastructure supports a one-day bounded reproduction.
judgment.next_action_zh: 一天内用公开 harness 重跑 20 个代表任务，核对成功率、墙钟时间和单任务成本是否可复现。
judgment.next_action_en: Within one day, rerun 20 representative tasks with the public harness and check success, wall time and cost per task.

judgment.judgment_zh: Olmo-core 3 是少见的开放万亿参数 MoE 训练参考栈，代码和设计都可检查。公开吞吐是短时随机路由结果，团队应先在较小集群验证持续训练行为。
judgment.judgment_en: Olmo-core 3 is a rare open reference stack for trillion-parameter MoE training, with inspectable code and design. Published throughput is based on short random-routing tests, so teams should validate sustained behavior on smaller clusters first.
judgment.next_action_zh: 先在 8–32 张现有 GPU 上验证路由均衡、checkpoint 恢复、通信占比和持续吞吐。
judgment.next_action_en: Validate routing balance, checkpoint recovery, communication share and sustained throughput on 8–32 existing GPUs first.

judgment.judgment_zh: Dots 已把持续运行、应用连接和独立云端电脑做成可用产品，但访问、后续计价和企业治理仍在变化。
judgment.judgment_en: Dots productize persistent execution, app connections and individual cloud computers, but access, later pricing and enterprise governance remain unsettled.
judgment.next_action_zh: 等待后续计价和企业控制说明，再复核真实任务完成率、撤权、审计与应用连接边界。
judgment.next_action_en: Wait for post-trial pricing and enterprise controls, then reassess task completion, revocation, audit and app boundaries.

judgment.judgment_zh: AstaBrief-8B 是可下载、许可宽松的引文报告模型，但引文质量和较小的人评样本仍需独立核验。
judgment.judgment_en: AstaBrief-8B is a downloadable, permissively licensed cited-report model, but citation quality and the small human study still need independent verification.
judgment.next_action_zh: 在一天内用本地论文集测引文精确率、召回率、延迟与过度归纳。
judgment.next_action_en: In one day, test citation precision, recall, latency and overclaiming on a local paper corpus.

judgment.judgment_zh: PixelUMM 的统一像素空间架构可检查，但 checkpoint 为非商业许可，训练配方和生产证据都不完整。
judgment.judgment_en: PixelUMM's unified pixel-space architecture is inspectable, but its checkpoint is noncommercial and both the training recipe and production evidence are incomplete.
judgment.next_action_zh: 等待完整训练配方、商业许可或独立复现后再投入算力。
judgment.next_action_en: Wait for a complete training recipe, commercial license or independent reproduction before allocating compute.

judgment.judgment_zh: Strands Decider 是公开权重、训练代码与评测记录齐全的小型 decision model，适合验证 agent 路由和工具选择，但作者指标仍需在真实分布上复现。
judgment.judgment_en: Strands Decider is a small decision model with public weights, training code and evaluation records, suitable for agent routing and tool-selection trials; author results still need reproduction on real distributions.
judgment.next_action_zh: 一天内用真实路由与工具选择样本比较延迟、校准、拒答率和错误代价。
judgment.next_action_en: In one day, compare latency, calibration, abstention and error cost on real routing and tool-selection samples.

judgment.judgment_zh: MAI Speech 提供可调用的低延迟流式转写与语音合成，并公布价格；多语质量和真实通话中的打断恢复仍需独立验证。
judgment.judgment_en: MAI Speech offers callable low-latency streaming transcription and synthesis with published pricing; multilingual quality and interruption recovery on real calls still need independent validation.
judgment.next_action_zh: 一天内用中英混合真实通话测首 token 延迟、错误率、打断恢复、自然度和每轮成本。
judgment.next_action_en: In one day, test mixed Chinese-English calls for first-token latency, error rate, interruption recovery, naturalness and per-turn cost.

judgment.judgment_zh: Index-Translate 公开了 Apache-2.0 预览权重和推理代码，能直接验证术语与结构化输出约束；厂商基准和预览状态不支持直接上线。
judgment.judgment_en: Index-Translate provides Apache-2.0 preview weights and inference code for direct tests of terminology and structured-output constraints; vendor-only benchmarks and preview status do not support production use.
judgment.next_action_zh: 一天内跑术语、JSON 与低资源语言样本，对比质量、约束遵循、延迟和显存。
judgment.next_action_en: In one day, run terminology, JSON and low-resource samples and compare quality, constraint following, latency and memory.

judgment.judgment_zh: UI-Venus-2 的 9B 权重与框架已公开，可在隔离环境验证跨界面任务；权重许可证仍待确认，不能用于商业部署。
judgment.judgment_en: UI-Venus-2's 9B weights and framework are public for isolated cross-interface evaluation, but the weight license remains pending and blocks commercial deployment.
judgment.next_action_zh: 一天内在隔离环境跑移动、网页和桌面任务；商业使用前等待明确许可证。
judgment.next_action_en: In one day, run mobile, web and desktop tasks in isolation; wait for a clear license before commercial use.

judgment.judgment_zh: Kolibri 为德英双语 RAG、工具调用和长文档提供开放权重与 serving plugin，厂商评测仍需独立复现。
judgment.judgment_en: Kolibri provides open weights and a serving plugin for German-English RAG, tool calling and long documents; vendor evaluations still need independent reproduction.
judgment.next_action_zh: 一天内比较德英双语 RAG、工具调用、262K 长文质量、延迟和显存。
judgment.next_action_en: In one day, compare German-English RAG, tool calling, 262K document quality, latency and memory.

judgment.judgment_zh: Naive-N0.5-Flash 是原生 1M 上下文的开放稀疏模型，但约 315 GB 权重和厂商基准把试验限定在 FP8 集群。
judgment.judgment_en: Naive-N0.5-Flash is an open sparse model with native 1M context, but roughly 315 GB of weights and vendor benchmarks limit trials to FP8 clusters.
judgment.next_action_zh: 一天内在 FP8 集群测 128K/1M 质量、首 token、吞吐、显存和输出一致性。
judgment.next_action_en: In one day on an FP8 cluster, test 128K/1M quality, first token, throughput, memory and output parity.

judgment.judgment_zh: ds4 在高内存工作站上为少数大型 MoE 提供专用本地运行时和明显采用信号，但模型范围窄且仍是 beta。
judgment.judgment_en: ds4 offers a specialized local runtime and strong adoption signal for a few large MoEs on high-memory workstations, but model coverage is narrow and the software remains beta.
judgment.next_action_zh: 一天内在目标硬件测加载、首 token、长上下文吞吐、重启恢复和输出一致性。
judgment.next_action_en: In one day on target hardware, test load time, first token, long-context throughput, restart recovery and output parity.

judgment.judgment_zh: ThinkingBox 直接核验数据库终态与副作用，公开 harness 已足够进入重复性试验。
judgment.judgment_en: ThinkingBox directly grades terminal state and side effects; the public harness is ready for repeatability trials.
judgment.next_action_zh: 一天内选 10 个工作流各跑 5 次，对比 pass@1、数据库终态和多余副作用。
judgment.next_action_en: In one day, run 10 workflows five times each and compare pass@1, terminal database state and extra side effects.

judgment.judgment_zh: DiarizationLM 提供本地可跑权重，适合验证说话人标签修正，但会议证据仍小。
judgment.judgment_en: DiarizationLM ships runnable local weights for speaker-label correction, but meeting evidence remains small.
judgment.next_action_zh: 一天内用公开 GGUF 跑一组双人通话和多人会议，比较 WDER、cpWER、延迟、内存与说话人漂移。
judgment.next_action_en: In one day, run the public GGUF on calls and meetings, comparing WDER, cpWER, latency, memory and speaker drift.

judgment.judgment_zh: Strata 的采用增长与异构 serving 设计值得试验，性能与低比特质量仍需独立验证。
judgment.judgment_en: Strata merits a trial for adoption and heterogeneous serving, while speed and low-bit quality need independent checks.
judgment.next_action_zh: 一天内在一台 12–24 GB GPU 主机对比 Q2 与官方端点的质量、TTFT、速度、内存和重启行为。
judgment.next_action_en: In one day, compare Q2 with the official endpoint on a 12–24 GB GPU, measuring quality, TTFT, speed, memory and restart behavior.

judgment.judgment_zh: Ataraxos 有论文和训练代码，但没有 checkpoint，当前只应观察。
judgment.judgment_en: Ataraxos has a paper and training code but no checkpoint, so it remains watch-only.
judgment.next_action_zh: 等预训练 checkpoint 或独立训练复现公开后，再评估它对隐藏信息规划任务的可迁移性。
judgment.next_action_en: Reassess transfer to hidden-information planning after pretrained checkpoints or an independent training reproduction appears.

judgment.judgment_zh: Figma hosted MCP 使用客户端白名单，接入前必须确认目录资格。
judgment.judgment_en: Figma hosted MCP uses a client allowlist, so catalog eligibility must be checked before integration.
judgment.next_action_zh: 依赖 hosted Figma MCP 前确认客户端仍在 Catalog；未列入时改用受支持的 desktop 路径或加入 waitlist。
judgment.next_action_en: Before relying on hosted Figma MCP, verify the client remains listed; otherwise use a supported desktop path or join the waitlist.

judgment.judgment_zh: textGrain 已进入 API opt-in 与欧盟产品分阶段开放，但短文本、改写和封闭检测器限制了独立验证。
judgment.judgment_en: textGrain has entered API opt-in and phased EU product rollout, but short text, rewriting attacks and a restricted detector limit independent validation.
judgment.next_action_zh: 等检测器开放后，用业务文本测试短文本、同义改写和误报，再决定是否接入内容溯源。
judgment.next_action_en: Wait for detector access, then test short text, synonym edits and false positives on domain samples before adopting provenance checks.

judgment.judgment_zh: 下载量很高，但可复现和独立评测不足，现阶段不值得投入。
judgment.judgment_en: Downloads are high, but reproducible and independent evaluation is insufficient, so the models do not merit investment yet.
judgment.next_action_zh: 暂不投入；等公开可复现 benchmark 或独立评测后再重新评估。
judgment.next_action_en: Do not invest yet; reassess after a reproducible benchmark package or independent evaluation appears.

judgment.judgment_zh: 固定开场 token 能显著改变基础模型推理与拒答行为，但效果仍可能依赖模型、解码与任务。
judgment.judgment_en: Fixed opening tokens can materially change base-model reasoning and refusal behavior, but effects may depend on model, decoding and task.
judgment.next_action_zh: 一天内用公开 demo 固定随机种子，对 20 道 MATH-500 比较无 cue 与两种 cue 的正确率、输出长度和拒答变化。
judgment.next_action_en: Within one day, use the public demo on 20 MATH-500 items with fixed seeds and compare accuracy, output length and refusal changes across no cue and two cues.

judgment.judgment_zh: MemPilot 把多模态记忆整理变成运行时质量、成本与延迟的路由问题；公开代码足以做有边界的验证。
judgment.judgment_en: MemPilot turns multimodal memory curation into a runtime quality, cost and latency routing problem; public code supports a bounded trial.
judgment.next_action_zh: 一天内用公开代码跑一个小型长会话切片，比较固定记忆与按需整理的答案质量、模型调用成本和延迟。
judgment.next_action_en: Within one day, run a small long-session slice with the public code and compare answer quality, model-call cost and latency against fixed memory.

judgment.judgment_zh: BazaarBench 公开了能检查库存、承诺和交易后果的 agent marketplace 安全评测栈。
judgment.judgment_en: BazaarBench provides a public marketplace-agent safety stack that checks inventory, commitments and transaction consequences.
judgment.next_action_zh: 一天内用公开市场快照跑一组普通与对抗场景，核对重复售卖、无货成交和声誉损失是否能被现有护栏拦截。
judgment.next_action_en: Within one day, run one public market state under normal and adversarial prompts and check whether existing guards catch double-selling, unavailable sales and reputation loss.

judgment.judgment_zh: OPPD 可能把多候选推理搜索蒸馏进一次生成，但作者结果需要按完整算力成本复现。
judgment.judgment_en: OPPD may distill multi-candidate reasoning search into one generation, but author results need reproduction with full compute accounting.
judgment.next_action_zh: 一天内用公开代码在一个小模型和 100 道 MATH-500 上复现单次生成收益，并记录训练算力与 GRPO 基线。
judgment.next_action_en: Within one day, use the public code on one small model and 100 MATH-500 items, recording single-generation gains, training compute and a GRPO baseline.

judgment.judgment_zh: Falcon-Emirati 展示地区方言模型的价值，但当前只有聊天入口，无法独立部署或复核。
judgment.judgment_en: Falcon-Emirati shows the value of regional dialect models, but chat-only access blocks independent deployment and verification.
judgment.next_action_zh: 等权重或 API 开放后，用真实阿联酋客服语料复测方言理解、文化常识和标准阿拉伯语回退。
judgment.next_action_en: Reassess when weights or an API open, using real Emirati support data to test dialect understanding, cultural knowledge and MSA fallback.

judgment.judgment_zh: Beam 仍是限量预览，权重和评测材料尚未发布。
judgment.judgment_en: Beam remains a limited preview; weights and evaluation artifacts are not yet released.
judgment.next_action_zh: 等 Apache 2.0 权重、model card 和复现脚本真正发布后，再测显存需求、吞吐和 coding benchmark。
judgment.next_action_en: Wait for the Apache 2.0 weights, model card and reproduction scripts, then measure memory, throughput and coding benchmarks.

judgment.judgment_zh: agent 产出了可审计的材料计算假设，但关键性质尚无实验确认。
judgment.judgment_en: Agents produced an auditable materials hypothesis, but key properties lack experimental confirmation.
judgment.next_action_zh: 等独立实验测出带隙和自旋分离后，再把该工作流视为材料发现能力证据。
judgment.next_action_en: Wait for independent experimental measurements of band gap and spin sorting before treating the workflow as evidence of materials-discovery capability.

judgment.judgment_zh: 已验证的外部性事件表明生产 agent 必须具备身份、出口、限流与可归因审计。
judgment.judgment_en: A verified externality incident shows production agents need identity, egress, rate and attributable audit controls.
judgment.next_action_zh: 为生产 agent 强制可识别 User-Agent、目标域 allowlist、请求配额、熔断和逐任务审计日志。
judgment.next_action_en: Require identifiable User-Agents, destination allowlists, request quotas, circuit breakers and per-task audit logs for production agents.

judgment.judgment_zh: Dust 公开了不用反向传播训练 Transformer 的最小实现，但离生产效率仍差几个数量级。
judgment.judgment_en: Dust publishes a minimal transformer training implementation without backprop, but remains orders of magnitude from production efficiency.
judgment.next_action_zh: 一天内用公开单 GPU 配置跑两步 smoke test，再以同一 1M-token 数据比较 Dust 与 SGD 的损失、显存和前向计算量。
judgment.next_action_en: Within one day, run the public single-GPU two-step smoke test, then compare Dust and SGD on the same 1M-token data for loss, memory and forward-pass compute.

judgment.judgment_zh: Large 4 已有 public preview API，权重与完整技术材料尚待发布。
judgment.judgment_en: Large 4 has a public preview API; weights and complete technical artifacts are still pending.
judgment.next_action_zh: 一天内通过 preview API 跑多模态工具调用、长上下文和 160+ 语言中的目标语种测试，并记录延迟、成本与失败恢复。
judgment.next_action_en: Within one day, use the preview API to test multimodal tool use, long context and target languages, recording latency, cost and recovery failures.
